BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: IMF   SEMESTER: IV
BRANCH: FOOD TECHNOLOGY  SESSION : SP/2019

SUBJECT : IMF4007 FRUITS & VEGETABLES PROCESSING

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Define the terms “fruit” and write about Climacteric fruits & Non-Climacteric fruits. [2]
 (b) Explain the changes may occur in fruits and vegetables during ripening? [3]


Q2 (a) Describe The Multiple Fruits & Hesperidium Fruits, with suitable examples. [2]
 (b) Describe the methods of pre-cooling. [3]


Q3 (a) Describe the term Low temperature preservation and discuss advantages of use of Low
temperature preservation.
[2]
 (b) Write about the Microbial spoilage, Autolytic spoilage (enzymatic) and Oxidative spoilage. [3]


Q4 (a) Define the term “Food preservation”. What are the basic objectives for the preservation
of foods?
[2]
 (b) Describe the freezing process and freezing damages. [3]


Q5 (a) What are the objectives of Thermal processing of fruits & vegetables? [2]
 (b) Write about the different treatments which can be applied at the time of blanching for
textural, coluor and flavour improvement of fruits & vegetables?
[3]


Q6 (a) Define the term “Blanching”. Why it is necessary in processing of fruit & vegetables? [2]
 (b) Describe the nutritional losses those can occur during blanching by hot water. [3]
